## Overview

A massive cave system containing vast formations of arcane-reactive crystals. The cave lies beneath the two surface cities of the Last Stand — Skywatch and Weaveheart — and extends to the side of the underground city of Emberforge, blanketing the entire area where the nutrient-rich forests grow on the surface.

## Geography

The cave is massive in scale, stretching beneath the heartland forests that surround the three capitals. Its ambient energy seeps upward through the soil, supercharging the fertility of the forests above and making them exceptionally productive for agriculture.

## The Crystals

The cave contains arcane-reactive crystals in formations ranging from tiny grains to massive clusters. These crystals are condensed remnants of B's essence, carrying a trace of the sacrificed Original's subconscious will. They react differently to each school of magic and can create dead magic zones and wild magic zones.

## Ecological Impact

The cave's ambient energy is responsible for the exceptional fertility of the forests surrounding the three capitals. Without this influence, the agricultural output of the region would be significantly lower — a fact known only to a handful of researchers.

## Mystery

The cave's full extent has never been mapped. What lies deeper within is unknown. The crystals may be growing, changing, or responding to something in ways scholars have not yet observed. This is an active plot hook for the campaign.
